item_short_desc: The Silva Explorer 2.0 Compass is the perfect compass for your next outdoor adventure.
description: The Silva Explorer 2.0 Compass is the perfect compass for your next outdoor adventure. The Silva compass features DryFlex™ grip for easy handling and comes with a use-anywhere declination scale inside the capsule, a magnifying lens, and base plate map-measuring in inches and scales of 1:62.5k mile & 1:24k USGS scale.
